title: Al-Badi', the Incomparable Originator
hook: the Incomparable Originator, making without a model (2:117)
tomorrow: a whole sheep given away. why would he say it 'remains'?

segments.voice: Yesterday, Al-Hadi, the Guide, and a line you can say on any road: guide me. Today, the Name that comes before any road, or map, existed at all.

Saturday, Dadi's apartment, half in boxes. Amira is taping the kitchen when she finds a pillowcase under the bed, and inside it a quilt: blue squares, orange triangles, one strip cut from an old school uniform. She asks which pattern it came from. Dadi laughs. "No pattern. I started with one square and kept going." Amira holds it up to the window. Everything she has ever made started from a tutorial, a template, someone else's version. This came from a woman, a needle and nothing to copy. So where does a thing come from when there was nothing before it?
screen: `A QUILT IN A PILLOWCASE.` → `NO PATTERN. I KEPT GOING.` → `NOTHING TO COPY.`

segments.voice: The Qur'an answers with a Name. In Surah al-Baqarah, in Pickthall's words: "The Originator of the heavens and the earth! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is." The Name is Al-Badi', the Originator. Classical explanations of the Names describe it as making without a model: no blueprint before, no earlier sky to improve on. Dadi's quilt is the human version, and even she had cloth, thread and other quilts behind her hands. Al-Badi' had none of that. Look how short the verse keeps it. No sketch, no second draft. Be, and it is. In Arabic that command is a single short word, kun. That's the line to tell a friend tonight: the whole sky answers to one syllable. So Muslims say people make, and Allah originates. We arrange what was already given; He gives the first thing. Some readers find a second gift hiding here. If the Originator copies nothing, then no person is a copy either. Not you, not the kid next to you on the bus, not any face in the long line of human faces. Each one, without precedent.
screen: `BE! AND IT IS.` · `MAKING WITHOUT A MODEL.` · `PEOPLE ARRANGE; HE ORIGINATES.` · `NO PERSON IS A COPY.` · then, large: `WITHOUT PRECEDENT.`

segments.voice: Find one thing near you that exists only once: the crack in your mug, a scar on your knuckle, the swirl of your own fingertip. Look at it for the whole sit as if it had just been made. In a way, it was.
screen: `ONE THING THAT EXISTS ONCE.` · `LOOK AS IF IT'S NEW.`

segments.voice: Al-Badi'. The Originator, who makes without a model, and says to a thing only: Be.
For the road: without precedent, the heavens, the earth, and the face in your mirror. Name ninety-five, gathered.

Your teacher. Even Allah's making follows a plan that existed before it.
chat.meaning: Al-Badi' originates without precedent: Be, and it is. People, even Dadi, make from what was already given.
